title: Just The Emerald Remote
description: This mod adds just the emerald remote from my Emerald Tools & Armor mod.
body:
This mod adds just the emerald remote from my Emerald Tools & Armor mod.  

Some things got changed but ultimately it's the same thing.

If you didn't see how it works, here's how:

- Craft an Emerald Megablock (not actually a block) from 4 emerald blocks.
- Craft 6 emerald megablocks in a trapdoor pattern and a soul torch on the top middle
to make the remote.
- Right-click the remote to spawn emerald blocks around you and give you 16 emeralds.
